title: Sleep Hygiene: Simple Practices for Better Rest
text:
# Sleep Hygiene: Simple Practices for Better Rest

Going to bed and waking up at the same time every day, weekends included, steadies the body clock.

A bedroom kept dark, quiet and cool, around 18 degrees C, helps most adults sleep.

Caffeine can stay in the body for six hours or more, so avoid it in the afternoon.
